utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hana, I’m glad the drive is tomorrow, but I’m worried about the morning drop-off—can we make sure there’s a labeled table at the hall entrance before people start arriving?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, Pia — that sounds important; I’ll check who has the hall setup list and make sure the entrance table is labeled before drop-off starts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thank you, Hana—could you also make sure there’s a spot for the request list at that table, so Cleo’s notes don’t get separated from the items?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I’m bringing my toolbox, drill, socket set, and extension cords for the repair drive, and I’ll be out front before 9 Saturday to help Noah set up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Gus—please label the cords and check in with Noah out front before 9. We’ll use your tools for safety fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Leo — I’ll label the cords tonight and check in with Noah out front before 9 so we can tackle the safety fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m checking around today on space, clipboards, and drop-off helpers, and I’ll cross-check it with Hana’s list so we’re not guessing. Sounds like Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room is set, so the main thing is tightening up intake.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Tess — I’ll tell folks Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room is set, and that we still need drop-off helpers plus intake supplies confirmed against Hana’s list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Vik—tell them to send any offers my way, and I’ll match them against Hana’s list before we promise anything. I’ll especially keep an eye out for drop-off coverage and clipboards.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Uli, I’m gathering repair requests and the supplies each one needs, then I’ll get the first list to Rosa by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll keep quietly mentioning the drive today, and if anyone offers tools or a repair request, I’ll pass the details along to Sam and you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli—that helps a lot. If anyone mentions tools, please note what they can lend and when, so I can match it with the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, I’m pulling together Eli’s repair list and comparing spots now—do you know anyone from your side who could bring tools or lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—I’m in for one slot, though I need the exact time/place. I’ll also nudge a couple tool-heavy folks on my side and send you names if they’re free.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Bo — I’m still pinning down the best spot with the repair list, and I’ll send you the exact time and place as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rey, I’m still catching repair drive details second-hand—Dane mentioned Hana may have the real list, but have you heard what’s still most needed?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve only heard safety fixes are the priority, and Faye said to bring basic tools, gloves, spare screws, and patch supplies for Saturday 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps a lot, thanks — I’ll pass along that safety fixes are the focus and check with Hana about any specific gaps before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Eli, the repair drive’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’m helping coordinate check-in and getting folks to the right tables—can you pitch in that day?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Sam, I can pitch in Sunday, but I’ll need the exact start time and a clear check-in list so we don’t duplicate work.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Eli—that’s a big help. I’ll confirm the exact start time with Rosa and make sure we have one clear check-in list for everyone to use.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Faye, I’m catching up late as usual, but I’m checking with Cleo on the needs list before Friday and keeping Sunday’s safety fixes at the top.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — that helps a lot. Since the drive is Saturday 10 to 2, please send me whatever Cleo confirms by Friday and flag anything that needs to carry over to Sunday’s safety fixes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll send you Cleo’s confirmed list by Friday and mark anything that should carry over to Sunday’s safety fixes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Opal! I’ve got the details and I’m already spreading the word: Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, small appliances, lamps, bikes, and torn clothing welcome—no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Quinn—thank you for keeping the details exactly right. If anyone asks, the drop-off and repair tables will both be in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it, Opal—I’ll tell folks both drop-off and repair tables are in the community room, Saturday 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, I’m still piecing it together: small appliances are definitely being collected, Gus has tools at 9 Saturday, and Oren’s sorting labels, but lamps and chairs are still being confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Ira—that matches what I’ve got, I think. I had tomorrow at the hall with drop-off first and sorting after lunch, and Gus out front a little before 9 Saturday with tools and cords.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That helps, Noah—I’ll pass along that drop-off is tomorrow at the hall and sorting’s after lunch, with Gus out front just before 9 Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina, the repair drive is Saturday from 10 to 2 in the community room—are you able to help with intake, repairs, or sorting items?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help with intake, but first who has the current fix-list and helper sign-up so we don’t duplicate work?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Mina — Quinn has the current fix-list, and I’m keeping the helper sign-up, so I’ll sync with Quinn and make sure your intake slot is added without duplicating anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oren, just to confirm, are you actually available to help with the repair drive on Saturday from 10 to 2? I need a firm yes before I count on you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, Kira — firm yes, Saturday 10 to 2 for the repair drive. I’ll write it down again so it doesn’t wander off.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, thank you—that’s the firm yes I needed, Oren. I’ll count you in for Saturday 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Rosa, I’m checking in on repair drive logistics—Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room—and I’m asking who can lend clipboards, sorting space, or help with drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess—quick update, it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, with safety fixes first. Clipboards and sorting space would be wonderful, and if you can help coordinate drop-offs, I’ll add you to that list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you for catching me up, Rosa—I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center and safety fixes come first. Put me down for coordinating drop-offs, and I’ll keep asking around for clipboards and sorting space.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do you know who has the current repair list and which helpers are already committed? I’m trying not to have three people chasing the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think Hana asked me to send the reported repairs and mark what’s urgent or already covered, but I’m not sure I’ve got the current list myself. Cleo or Vik may have the up-to-date version, and I’ve noted Bo for one slot plus pickup if Faye gives the time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, please send Hana what you do have today and mark Bo’s slot clearly; I’ll check with Cleo and Vik for the current list so we don’t duplicate calls.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Gus, since you’re bringing tools and cords tomorrow, can you make sure they’re labeled, and do you know who’s actually checking items in at the hall entrance?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Pia — I’ll put my name on the toolbox and cords tonight. I’m not sure who’s on check-in at the hall entrance yet, but I can ask Noah or Mara when I get there before 9.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus—could you also keep your cords together until check-in is settled, just so nothing gets mixed into the repair pile before we’ve logged it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Ira, I’m gathering repair requests and the supplies each job needs so Rosa can match volunteers by Friday. If you hear of anyone needing a fix, send me their name and what’s broken.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Cleo — so far I’ve heard small appliances are confirmed, Gus is bringing tools at 9 Saturday, and Oren’s helping sort and label. I’m still trying to pin down which lamps and chairs need fixing, and I’ll send names as soon as Mina confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — I’ll mark small appliances, Gus’s tools at 9, and Oren on sorting and labeling. Send me Mina’s lamp and chair names when you have them, and I’ll add the supply needs for Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m just pulling the pieces together now—Eli has the repair list, and I promised Hana I’d compare spots and send over the urgent items once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — that sounds good. Once you compare the spots, send me the urgent items too so I can keep the Saturday 10 to 2 setup on track.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Mara — I’ll send you the urgent items as soon as I get Eli’s list and line it up with the best spot, so Saturday 10 to 2 stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Noah, I’m still in for the repair drive now that it’s moved to Sunday at the community center. I can help check people in and point them to the right repair table if that’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—Sunday at the community center, right, I nearly had tomorrow at the hall stuck in my head. Check-in and directing folks would be a huge help, Sam, thank you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and handle check-in and directing folks. I’ll plan to arrive a little early so we can get set up smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hi Opal, I’m joining a bit late—Rosa said the drive is Sunday at the community center and safety fixes come first. Do you have your availability list yet, or any gaps you’ve heard are still uncovered?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got it noted as Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, not Sunday, so I’ll double-check where Rosa heard that. I don’t have a full availability list yet—so far Sam can help and Quinn is spreading the word, but coverage gaps are still likely setup, intake, and pickup flow.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal—if you can confirm Saturday versus Sunday, I’ll hold off repeating a date. I’ll check back with Rosa and Hana on the safety-triage side, and I’ll flag setup, intake, and pickup flow as likely gaps for now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Rey — before I sort anything, do you have any reported repairs or volunteer names I should add, especially anything urgent for Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t have new names yet, Hana, but Rosa said safety fixes are the priority, and I’m bringing labeled basic tools, gloves, spare screws, and patch supplies for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I’ll mark safety fixes as the first priority and note your labeled tools and supplies for Saturday morning. If any repair names come in, please send them along before I sort the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Quick version from me: I’m in for one repair drive slot, and I can cover an after-school pickup/drop-off window if you send the exact time and place.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — the drive is Saturday 10 to 2, so could you take the late-morning slot, and I’ll send the exact pickup details once I confirm the school timing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, late-morning Saturday works—just send me the pickup time and place once it’s nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Quinn, before I repeat this to everyone, can you confirm one more time: Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, small repairs only, and absolutely no hazardous items?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, exactly—this Saturday from 10 to 2 in the community room, small appliances, lamps, bikes, or torn clothing only, and absolutely no hazardous items. Thanks for helping spread it, Kira!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, thanks—now I’m comfortable repeating it exactly that way, and I’ll make sure people understand no hazardous items means no exceptions.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Uli, I’m still getting repair drive updates second-hand—Tess mentioned space to sort, clipboards for tracking, and steady hands for drop-offs. Have you heard if Hana’s list says the same?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t seen Hana’s list myself, Nell—just heard from Quinn and Tess. I can quietly ask around today and pass any tool offers or drop-off names to Sam.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Uli—that would help a lot. I’ll keep pointing folks toward Hana’s list, and if you hear anything concrete from Quinn or Tess, I can help pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Leo, here’s what I know so far: we’re collecting broken small appliances, and Oren’s handling sorting and labels on Saturday morning. I’m still waiting on Mina to confirm the full signup list and any specific items that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik. Please ask Mina for the signup list by tonight, and tell Oren to label safety-risk items first Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Leo — I’ll ask Mina for the signup list by tonight and let Oren know to mark the safety-risk items first on Saturday morning.
